_comment: Character class catalog (real data drives the schema). Each class carries movement range, a casting_type list, a list of non-spell class_abilities, and an allowable_item_types list gating which weapon and armor item_types the class may equip. `casting_type` ties the class to the spell catalog — values are `none` (no spells), `sorcerer` (arcane/INT-flavored), or `priest` (divine/WIS-flavored); Druid is the only class with both. Spell eligibility is purely casting_type-based: any class with a matching catalog can cast any spell in that catalog. Per-class level overrides for specific spells live on Spell.class_min_levels. Per-class item gating lives here on `allowable_item_types` (values are Item.item_type) — Item.party_can_equip / Item.character_can_equip still controls equip *scope* (party vs. character slot) but no longer carries any class info. XP-per-level lives on Race. Pruned v1 relics that the v2 engine no longer reads: hp_per_level, mp_per_level, allowed_races, mp_source, exp_per_level, and (most recently) Spell.allowable_classes.

class_abilities.name: Pick Locks
class_abilities.description: A Thief can pick locked doors and chests (d20 + DEX mod vs DC 12), consuming one lockpick per attempt.

class_abilities.name: Detect Traps
class_abilities.description: A Thief's keen eye reveals hidden traps before the party steps on them.

class_abilities.name: Backstab
class_abilities.description: From level 3, a Thief lands critical hits with daggers on a successful DEX save, turning the humble dagger into a devastating weapon.

class_abilities.name: Shadow Step
class_abilities.description: From level 7, a Thief can move after attacking — true hit-and-run play.

class_abilities.name: Turn Undead
class_abilities.description: From level 2, a Cleric can channel holy energy to Turn Undead: every undead on the battlefield must make a Wisdom save or be destroyed; those that succeed still take 50% of their HP in radiant damage.

class_abilities.name: Dual Casting
class_abilities.description: Druids draw from both the priest and sorcerer spell catalogs — the only class with access to both.

class_abilities.name: Herbalism
class_abilities.description: Druidic nature lore spots reagents in the wild. When the party examines a tile, each Druid rolls an INT save (d20 + INT mod vs DC 13) — success identifies a potion reagent.

class_abilities.name: Turn Undead
class_abilities.description: From level 5, a Paladin can channel holy energy to Turn Undead: every undead on the battlefield must make a Wisdom save or be destroyed; those that succeed still take 50% of their HP in radiant damage.

class_abilities.name: Pick Locks
class_abilities.description: From level 3, a Ranger can pick locked doors and chests (d20 + DEX mod vs DC 12), consuming one lockpick per attempt — same mechanic as a Thief.

class_abilities.name: Detect Traps
class_abilities.description: From level 3, a Ranger's woodcraft reveals hidden traps before the party steps on them.

class_abilities.name: Herbalism
class_abilities.description: Expert knowledge of ingredients doubles the chance of finding reagents when examining the wilderness.
